Description: Caster can check one object or place (up to a 5'R) and tell if it is an illusion or has an illusion on it

Detects all invisible objects or beings in the area of effect. Caster can concentrate on a different 5'R each round. All attacks against something so detected are modified by -50. See Section 7.1.10 for rules on invisibility
For the purposes of mental or magical detections, target appears to be of any race the caster chooses
As Misfeel Kind, except target's level may be misrepresented by 1 level (up or down)
Creates a false presence (for the purposes of magical detections) in the area of effect
As Misfeel Kind, except target's profession may be misrepresented
As Misfeel Power I, except target's level may be misrepresented by up to 3 levels (up or down)

As Misfeel Power I, except an object's power emanations may be reduced, so that a minor item's power is undetectable and major items seem like minor items (for spells such as Detect Essence, Detect Power, Detect Channeling, etc.)
As Misfeel Power I, except target's level may be misrepresented by up to 5 levels (up or down)
One illusion within the area of effect ceases to exist (for the caster only)
As Detect Illusion, except caster can concentrate on one object or place per round
As Misfeel Power I, except target's level can be misrepresented by up to 10 levels (up or down)
As Disillusion I, except up to three illusions within the area of effect cease to exist
Applies all the lower level Misfeels to a target at once (only one Misfeel Power can be applied)
As Misfeel Kind, except target appears to have no presence
As Disillusion I, except up to five illusions within the area of effect cease to exist
As Unpresence I, except will affect up to three targets
As Disillusion I, except all illusions within the area of effect cease to exist
As Unpresence I, except affects up to five targets
As Misfeel, except for duration
As Unpresence, except up to 20 targets may be affected

As Misfeel, except as many targets as the caster's level can be affected. SPECIAL NOTES See Section 7.1.27 for more information on illusions, mirages, etc. ILLUSIONIST BASE LIST 3.3.5 MIND SENSE MOLDING
